## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Jùshě Lùn Sòng Shū Xùjì* 俱舍論頌疏序記 (CBETA X53n838) is a Tang dynasty 1-juan text by the monk Fǎyíng 法盈 ([法盈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%9B%88)), associated with 圓暉's *Jùshě lùn sòng shū* ([KR6l0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0036), T1823). The catalog function is 修 (edited/revised). The text preserved in Xuzangjing Vol. 53, No. 838 apparently consists of introductory preface-notes clarifying the sequence and intent of 圓暉's commentary. The surviving file opens with an allegorical preface by a later publisher using the metaphor of mountain-climbing to describe the difficulty and reward of studying classical texts.

**Abstract**

Fǎyíng 法盈 (fl. late 7th–early 8th century CE) was a Tang Abhidharma monk whose connection to the 圓暉 tradition is reflected in this brief preface-commentary. The *Xùjì* 序記 genre denotes introductory explanatory notes accompanying a major commentary — here, 圓暉's *Sòng Shū*. The text's exact character and extent in its original form are uncertain, as the Xuzangjing edition preserves it with later editorial additions.
